title: docs(automation): the notify click-through default says a before-create run links to its record only when the caller wrote the id
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoAWWXVQzVyUxg58HrLRViak)_

Fixes #30759

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Text only; the runtime is unchanged. Triage 6674582930 routed the card to `domain:spec` as one PR over every surface that carries the wording, so no second dialect opens. The `notify-node.ts` hunks are `domain:server` code carried by the spec lane per that triage.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:notify 节点"不写链接就默认链到触发记录"的四处文案(spec 的 describe 与 docblock、服务端 notify 节点的 docblock 与配置说明、Flows 文档、automation skill 示例注释)现在写明:before-create 运行的记录还没有 id,只有调用方自己写了 id 时才会链接;`sourceId` 求值为 `null` 是"写了键但为空",半对被丢弃、不回退到默认。参考页 `io-node-config.mdx` 随之再生成。
- **为什么改**:原文把"删除以外的记录变更"都说成会链接,但 before-create 运行在驱动发 id 之前执行,通知其实不带链接;作者或 AI 会据此省掉 pair 而等不到链接。
- **风险与回滚**:零运行时改动;skill 文件净增 0 行、token 6443→6446(上限 6449)。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**:`packages/spec/src/automation/io-node-config.zod.ts`(docblock + 两条 describe)、`packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/notify-node.ts`(docblock、`null` 失败文案、两条 description)、`skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` :125。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run src/builtin/notify-node.test.ts`,预期 25/25 通过,其中两条新 pin:无 id 的 beforeInsert 运行不写 source,调用方写了 id 的则链接。
- **需要你做的**:Tier H(`skills/**`)——席位复审后交 os-zhuang 批准。

## What changes

- **The shared wording.** The four texts now enumerate the runs that link as "a record change other than a delete or a before-create, a time-relative sweep, an action on a record", and each says why a before-create run is out: its record is the write's input, and the driver issues the id at the write, after the hook, so it links only when the caller wrote the id (the card's precision note: the input carries an `id` only when the caller wrote one).
  - `packages/spec/src/automation/io-node-config.zod.ts`: the `NotifyConfigSchema` docblock bullet and the `sourceObject` / `sourceId` describes.
  - `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/notify-node.ts`: the `defaultClickThroughOf` docblock and the `sourceObject` / `sourceId` config descriptions (the wording source).
  - `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx`: the click-through paragraph.
  - `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` :125: `// trigger record (not on delete/before-create), if any` — the comment edited in place, net +0 lines, no re-wrap.
  - `content/docs/references/automation/io-node-config.mdx`: regenerated from the describes by `check:generated --fix`, not hand-edited.
- **The `null` clause.** `notify-node.ts`'s `sourceId` failure text and `flows.mdx` said a `null` "leaves the key unset". Both now say it is a written `sourceId` that resolves to nothing, so the pair is dropped rather than defaulted — what `defaultClickThroughOf` does, since it reads the written config, not the evaluated value.
- **Pins** in the existing `notify click-through defaults to the trigger record` describe of `notify-node.test.ts`: a notify on a `beforeInsert` run whose record carries no id writes no `source` (so no `source_object` / `source_id`) and no URL; one whose caller wrote the id links to it.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/30759-notify-click-through-before-create.md`: `@objectstack/spec` patch, `@objectstack/service-automation` patch, `@objectstack/skills` patch.

Measured on `origin/main` 6ff27b34 before editing: `record-before-create` → `beforeInsert` and `record-before-write` → `beforeInsert` + `beforeUpdate` (`packages/triggers/trigger-record-change/README.md` mapping table; `record-change-trigger.ts` :520 treats `beforeInsert` as the insert event), so the insert leg of `record-before-write` and `record-before-create` are the only before-create shapes. On that leg `buildContext` has no `ctx.result` and no `ctx.previous`, so `record` is `ctx.input.data` (:477-485); `driver-memory` `create` issues `id: data.id || this.generateId(object)` at the write (:845); `triggerRecordOf` needs both `context.object` and `context.record.id` (:155-159).

## Why

A before-create run is "a record change other than a delete", so the shipped text promised a link the runtime cannot make: the notification links nowhere, not to a dead link. An author or an AI leaving the pair out on a before-create notify expected a link that never comes.

## Tests

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/builtin/notify-node.test.ts` under the verify lock: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 25 passed (25)` (VERDICT command-exit 0).
- Reverse verification of the new pin, committed fix first: `triggerRecordOf` mutated on disk to `return object ? { object, id: id ?? 'PIN_ABLATION_ID' } : undefined` (1 hit of the marker, 0 of the original line), same run → `Tests 2 failed | 23 passed (25)`: `writes no source on a before-create run whose record has no id yet` and `links nowhere on a run with no trigger record` both red (VERDICT command-exit 1). Restored with `git checkout HEAD -- <path>`: `git hash-object` equals the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty; rerun 25/25.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation typecheck`: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Affected packages' own suites under the lock: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` VERDICT command-exit 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` VERDICT command-exit 0, `Tests 25838 passed | 1 todo (25839)`; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation test` VERDICT command-exit 0, `Tests 3431 passed (3431)`. `test:repo` (the vitest `repo` project) is CI's run (`Test Core`), not run here.

Three lines first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, nothing measured): `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` (its positive control is a commit the shallow clone could not reach; fetched that sha, rerun → exit 0, 48 cases), `check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (no `dist/` for the unbuilt packages; `pnpm build` under the lock, VERDICT command-exit 0, rerun → exit 0: 283 prose examples type-check; 116 entries / 71 packages / 2456 cjs files load). The ran list is `/mnt/project-files/spec-seat-1/out/30759-gates-ran-87404ae2.list`.
- Local-only readings (not derived, left local): `pnpm check:skill-frame-freshness` exit 0; `pnpm check:dev-prereqs` exit 1 — "the workspace is not built" (71 of 106 packages have no dist in this worktree, which built only `@objectstack/spec` and the `service-automation` closure); a precondition of this box, not a finding about the diff.
- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` 6446 tokens (ceiling 6449; headroom 3), from 6443 on main.
- Tier: `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --test skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md …` → Tier H (`skills/**`). Changed lines: 76 additions + 22 deletions, generated file included.
- `skills/**` readings, lines: `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` 452 before / 452 after; the whole published catalog (11 `SKILL.md` files) 4525 before / 4525 after. Tokens (`check-skills-token-ratchet`): 6443 before / 6446 after.
- Open PRs touching the same files at dispatch time (`gh api search/issues`): #30866 (`skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`, a different hunk at :127 and later; no overlap with :125) and #30875 (`skills/objectstack-platform/**`, no overlap). None touches `notify-node.ts` or `io-node-config.zod.ts`. The later lander merges `main`.

## Acceptance notes

- Two unconsumed changesets from the PRs that wrote the wording, `.changeset/30254-notify-default-link-skill.md` and `.changeset/30689-notify-click-through-default-describe.md`, repeat the old enumeration in their prose. Not edited here (another PR's release input); this PR's changeset states the corrected enumeration, and the release compiles both. Noted for the release-notes compiler, not filed.
- `packages/triggers/trigger-record-change/README.md`'s mapping table is the only in-repo text that states `record-before-write` fires on `beforeInsert` + `beforeUpdate`; the code spells the union through its hook registration, not a literal table. Read-only observation, not a defect.
- The spec describes and the `notify-node.ts` descriptions were not byte-identical before this PR (the spec adds "a literal," and "not defaulted"); this PR keeps each text's own frame and changes the shared enumeration and the before-create clause in all of them.
